name: Calix Support Cloud
description: Device, subscriber, provisioning record, and device group workflows backed by the Calix Support Cloud Integration Model.

serialNumber.description: The device serial number as reported in the TR-69 INFORM. For most Calix devices, this is the FSAN Serial Number starting with CXNK, not the Manufacturing Serial Number.

macAddress.description: The hardware MAC address as reported in the TR-69 INFORM, in the format 00:11:22:33:44:55

registrationId.description: The Calix ONT Registration ID (aka RONTA) as programmed locally on the device.

ipAddress.description: The WAN IP address as reported by TR-69 INFORM. If STUN is active, this searches the device's WAN IP, not the STUN binding IP.

limit.description: Number of records to return (1-500). Default 100.

skip.description: Offset, in number of records, to skip from the beginning of the returned values. Default 0.

customId.description: Displayed as "Subscriber ID" in Calix Support Cloud.

devices.description: Device IDs (FSAN/serial/RegID/MAC) associated with this location.

customId.description: The customId value, displayed as "Subscriber ID" in Calix Support Cloud. Must match exactly.

name.description: The subscriber's top-level "name" value. Must match exactly, and may return multiple matches.

phone.description: Phone number. May match multiple subscribers, as phone number is not required to be unique.

email.description: Email address. May match multiple subscribers, as email is not required to be unique.

limit.description: Number of records to return (1-500). Default 100.

skip.description: Offset, in number of records, to skip from the beginning of the returned values. Default 0.

_id.description: Internal subscriber record ID, assigned by Calix Support Cloud.

customId.description: Displayed as "Subscriber ID" in Calix Support Cloud.

devices.description: Device IDs (FSAN/serial/RegID/MAC) associated with this location.

subscriberId.description: Internal ID of the associated Subscriber record.

wifi.description: WiFi radio/SSID configuration, keyed by radio index.

deviceId.description: Device ID: FSAN Serial Number, serial number as reported in the TR-69 INFORM, Calix Registration ID, or MAC address (format 00:11:22:33:44:55).

subscriberId.description: Internal ID value of the associated Subscriber record.

limit.description: Number of records to return (1-500). Default 100.

skip.description: Offset, in number of records, to skip from the beginning of the returned values. Default 0.

cpeIdentifier.description: Identifies the target device by exactly one of its keys.

parameterNames.description: TR-069 data model object paths to retrieve (GetParameterValues) or a single path to list children of (GetParameterNames uses parameterPath instead).

parameterPath.description: TR-069 data model path to list child parameter names of (GetParameterNames).

parameterValues.description: Map of TR-069 data model object path to the value to set (SetParameterValues).

objectName.description: Full TR-069 data model object path, with a trailing dot (AddObject/DeleteObject).

memberInfo.description: One of: FSAN ID, serial number, Registration ID, or MAC address. Searches for membership information for a matching device.

bDiscovered.description: If present, return only Discovered devices (those which have successfully checked in to the ACS).

bUndiscovered.description: If present, return only devices which have not checked in to the ACS.

groupId.description: Internal ID of the Device Group.

memberInfo.description: FSAN ID, serial number, Registration ID, or MAC address of the device.
